name: Olentra company administration
implementation_scope: Frontend interface only; backend and live integrations are deferred
typography: Use the site's Manrope/Inter sans-serif family with clear heading, body, label and helper-text hierarchy.
desktop_shell: Persistent module sidebar, breadcrumbs, global search, environment/scope controls, notifications and account access.
mobile_shell: Compact header, stacked cards, large controls, sticky primary actions and four-item bottom navigation.
authentication_shell: Signed-out brand panel and authentication card; no signed-in sidebar, company data or owner profile.

feature_controls.public_visibility: Show or hide public pages, sections and navigation according to configured scope.
feature_controls.new_applications: Open or close intake independently of public page visibility.
feature_controls.existing_portal: Keep current interns' workspace access independent of public visibility and intake.

accessibility: State described by text as well as color
sample_data: Every metric, record, identity and integration state in these images is illustrative.
method: Built-in imagegen, one image per screen; exact generation and refinement prompts are retained in manifests and screen-index.json.
